title: darea furcata
intro: Darea furcata, commonly known as Kalmegh, is a plant species that belongs to the family Rutaceae and is native to tropical regions of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of D. furcata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to have a positive impact on various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of D. furcata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
